text:
maya: AM async — quick status: landed the kernel microbatch refactor branch and ran a short perf sweep. Blocker: KV warmup still shows p95 spikes on small-shard workloads. Today I'm iterating on eviction + handoff smoothing and opened a PR for review. cc @lucas @priya

lucas: nice. can you paste the raw perf numbers? also saw CI failure on the infra job a few runs ago: https://ci.internal/87654

maya: quick bench snippet i ran locally:
```
bench --model=redwood-xl --seq=512 --clients=64 --runs=3
p50: 11.8ms  p95: 48.3ms  p99: 122.7ms
with kv_prefetch=on -> p95: 31.9ms  p99: 85.4ms
with small-shard (shard-size=8) -> p95: 68ms (spiky)
```

priya: thanks — p99 is the red flag. do you know whether it's slot handoff or GC? can you try kv_prefetch.batch_size=8 and see?

maya: profiled the hotpath — stack points to mutex contention in slot_allocator during concurrent writes (hand-off bursts). GC looks normal. i'll try smoothing the handoff and add a perf test. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/789

sam: I can review the PR today. main comments: add an evict-boundary unit test and document the new config flags. also note the canary window is 2h for this rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: nightly-bench started on pool 'microburst' (job 88211) — ETA ~25m. logs: https://ci.internal/logs/88211

lucas: small datapoint — found a regression where the batching scheduler disables batching for seq < 32 in a codepath that shouldn't run for multi-client workloads. queued a tiny patch on top of your branch, @maya.

maya: thanks — i'll pull that patch in and add a fallback that forces batching.enabled=true for policy=throughput. blocker not fully resolved yet; still seeing p95 spikes after memmaps warm. will update when nightly finishes.

priya: :thumbsup: ping @sam when the PR is merged so we can start the canary. if nightly shows improvement, we can widen traffic after 30m.

sam: Roger — i'll prioritize review and run a quick canary checklist once merged.

maya: cool. keeping this thread as the single-source for followups. will post final nightly numbers here.
